title: In 1967, Martin Luther King Jr. preached at Shiloh Baptist Church; now it has a $750,000 grant
summary_full: Shiloh Baptist Church in Cleveland has secured a $750,000 grant to enhance its historic building. The funding aims to improve accessibility and support ongoing community services. Planned repairs include restoring the portico and addressing water damage throughout the church. This grant connects the church's rich history in civil rights activism to its future role in the community. The church aims to remain a vibrant space for worship and community engagement.
